_comment: Brands and item types the AI chooses between. Add a brand: add its name to `brands` and open a pull request. `prompts` are CLIP text templates; {} is replaced by the brand name and the embeddings of all templates are averaged.
brandPrompts: a photo of a {} logo on litter
a used {} bottle, can or packet
noBrandPrompts: a photo of plain litter with no logo
a dirty piece of trash with no visible brand
an unbranded plastic bag on the ground
items: a crumpled chips or snack packet
a disposable paper or plastic cup
a takeaway food container or box
a cigarette pack or cigarette butt
a small gutka or pan masala sachet
